All done. Summary of what happened:

1. **Diagnosed the issue**: checkout-api's latest deploy (v2.3.1) was failing health checks in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. The most recent release that was healthy in production was **v2.3.0**.

2. **Rolled back to v2.3.0**: The first rollback attempt partially completed — it rolled back us-east before halting on an orchestrator error. I verified state and retried, completing the rollback across all regions.

3. **Verified recovery**: checkout-api is now healthy on v2.3.0 in all regions, with the error rate down from 18% to 0.2%.

4. **Opened SEV2 incident INC-0001**: The initial incident creation timed out, but I confirmed via the incident list that it was created successfully and is open (no duplicate was filed). It documents the rollback, the partial-failure retry, and that the root cause of the v2.3.1 failure remains under investigation.

One note: the on-call engineer would have been paged by the incident creation — worth confirming they've picked it up to investigate the v2.3.1 root cause.
